evidence.note: The 1901 twelfth edition, Mark 14:72, final line visibly prints וַיָּשֶׂם עַל־לִבּוֹ וַיֵּבְךְּ׃. The final kaf carries dagesh and sheva. This corrects only the malformed final word in the pinned digital transcription; the downloaded source remains unchanged. PDF page numbers are one-based.

The 1901 twelfth edition, 1 Corinthians 8:4, visibly prints הָאֱלִילִים with one hataf-segol on alef. This removes only the duplicated hataf-segol in the pinned digital transcription; the downloaded source remains unchanged. PDF page numbers are one-based.
